provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training: The assistant caregiver lacked  documentation of 12 hours training to complete last years annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Television was playing in the playroom where five children under two years of age were being cared for. This was corrected at inspection as the provider turned off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant's feeding instructions had not been reviewed or updated by the parent or a health care professional since 5/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked an immunization record and one child's immunization record was observed incomplete. One child's record lacked a health statement. One child's record lacked a parent signature indicating the parent received a copy of the parent hnabook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed seated in a baby walker during inspection. This was corrected at inspection as it was removed from the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §747.2315(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation did not have Safety documentation for emergency drills, fire extinguishers, smoke detectors checks conducted for 2024 available for review by Child Care Regulation. The operation did not document fire exits times for fire drills conducted in 2023. The operation did not document a fire drill was conducted for October 2023; November 2023; and December 2023. The operation did not document that a smoke detector nor carbon monoxide detector check was conducted for the months of March 2023; October 2023; November 2023; and December 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked the address of the designated contact. One child's record lacked emergency care authorization. Two children's record's lacked documentation they received a copy of the Parents Rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher was not mounted in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The home did not have documentation of current vaccines for the cat in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The primary caregiver lacked documentation of 13 hours training to complete last year's annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training: The assistant caregiver lacked documentation of  8 hours of training to complete last year's annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Weapons In Homes Kept in Locked Cabinet, Inaccessible to Children: This standard was reviewed as a follow up to a previous inspection and found deficient. I was not able to observe the ammunition was locked in a separate container or cabinet from the fire arms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Weapons In Homes Kept in Locked Cabinet, Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3505(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete. Three children's record lacked a health statement. One child's record lacked emergency medical authorization. Provided a list of the children and their missing information to the primary caregiver at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The home did no have a statement of health from the local veterinarian on file for review for the puppy at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The home did not have documentation of current  rabbies vaccines for the cat at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: The primary caregivers record lacked a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §747.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Weapons In Homes Kept in Locked Cabinet, Inaccessible to Children: Observed guns on a gun rack in the home as well as on top of a gun safe. Ammunition was observed on top of a gun safe and not locked in a separate cabinet or container from other fire arms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Weapons In Homes Kept in Locked Cabinet, Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3505(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies were evaluated and lacked the following written procedures: Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F of this chapter (relating to Developmental Activities and Activity Plan). Your policies must include: (A) The duration of physical activity at your home, both indoor and outdoor;(B) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: The a/c unit on the playground does not have a safe guard to prevent children's access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The home did not have safety documentation for emergency drills, fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, and emergency evacuation on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
